inputMode: CN setup -> EN paused -> CN verification
setup: Preview only. Every independent case begins CN/Clear, selection OFF, modifiers unlit; main digits123, Home then ArrowRight, N08 for raw n. Switch to EN without confirming, verify paused n retained; tap one top editor control. Raw n/document123/caret/selection-off must remain. Cancel while EN, return CN, digit9 yields1923. Acer pen only; do not choose candidates, Space or Enter.
Clear while CN; digits 123; selection OFF; modifiers unlit
Home then ArrowRight: caret between 1 and 2
N08: raw n; tap language button once to EN
verify EN and paused raw n retained
verification: tap Cancel while still EN; paused n disappears, confirmed text remains
tap language button back to CN
tap main digit 9
